assumptions: Records were deduplicated by platform, episode, difficulty, area, monster, section ID, item and rate.
Box drops were removed when monster or area text looked like box/container/crate/barrel.
Best route means lowest expectedKills for the same item; ties are preserved.
Exclusive means the item appears only under one Section ID in the loaded data.
Top weapon/armor/unit/utility categories are heuristic name-based because no item-type table was present in the JSON.
Strategy uses all loaded platforms/difficulties together; the platform field is retained on every route.
